episodes.algorithm: peak-to-new-high underwater stretches over the real monthly growth index: the seed month is the initial running peak; an episode opens when the index falls strictly below the running peak (float noise guarded by the epsilon) and closes at the first month the index reaches the peak again; an episode qualifies when its worst trough depth (1 - trough/peak) is >= 0.15 inclusive; a qualifying episode still open at the series tail keeps empty recovery fields

name: 60_40_drawdown_episodes_real_v1
serialization: csv: utf-8, LF newlines, final newline, values via Python repr(); open episodes leave the recovery cells empty; sidecar json: json.dumps(obj, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + trailing newline

units.depth: decimal fraction of the peak lost at the worst trough (1 - trough/peak); 0.15 = a 15% drawdown
units.peak_value: growth index, decimal (real monthly-rebalanced 60/40; base 1.0 at 1871.01)
units.recovery_value: growth index, decimal (first month at or above the peak; same base; empty for an open episode)
units.trough_value: growth index, decimal (worst month of the episode; same base as peak_value)
